get.description: Visible models for one Profile or all accessible Profiles. Full catalogs and hidden-model aliases are omitted. Each group has model_count; allProviders contains preset descriptors with empty models. Load a full directory on demand with GET /api/hermes/provider-models.

api_mode.description: Null clears the custom connection protocol override for automatic matching; no api_mode is written to configuration.
Null clears the custom connection protocol override for automatic matching; no api_mode is written to configuration.

get.summary: Read the full model directory for one Provider
get.description: Settings-only on-demand catalog, including hidden models and their aliases. Reads configured/cached models for the authorized Profile, with preset fallback. Does not probe upstream endpoints or scan capability metadata. Credentials are never returned.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Authorized Profile; required here or in x-hermes-profile.

200.description: Complete Provider directory and current visible models

post.summary: Run chat and wait for completion
post.description: Starts a Ekko Studio chat run through the chat-run transport and waits for a terminal result. Use this from HTTP/MCP callers that cannot consume Socket.IO streams.

input.description: User message text or content blocks.

session_id.description: Optional session id. Omit this to create a new session automatically. Provide an existing session id to continue that session.

profile.description: Ekko Studio profile name. Defaults to the authenticated request profile or default.

provider.description: Model provider key to use for this run, for example openai, anthropic, deepseek, or a configured custom provider key.

model.description: Model id to use for this run, for example gpt-5.1 or deepseek-v4-pro.

source.description: Session source. Use cli for Hermes bridge runs, builtin_agent for native Ekko direct chats, coding_agent for external CLIs, or the matching group_chat/global_agent surface. Omit source for normal Hermes chat runs; do not use the legacy api_server source.

session_source.description: Marks a coding-agent or bridge session as launched from the global agent.

instructions.description: Optional extra run instructions appended after the system prompt.

workspace.description: Optional current working directory for the run.

coding_agent_id.description: Legacy coding-agent runtime id. Removed runtimes are read-only; new runs are rejected.

agent_id.description: Legacy runtime id. Removed runtimes are read-only; new runs are rejected.

baseUrl.description: Optional provider base URL for coding-agent runs.

apiKey.description: Optional provider API key for coding-agent runs.

apiMode.description: Optional provider wire API mode for coding-agent runs.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for run.completed or run.failed.

include_events.description: Include recorded run events in the HTTP response.

get.summary: List conversation tasks across accessible profiles
get.description: Lists persisted single-chat tasks, including archived sessions, with stable pagination. Profile access and pending deletions are applied before counting. Group and global-agent tasks are excluded. Open tasks precede completed tasks; update time and id determine stable order within each status. Does not invoke a model or modify task status.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional exact profile filter. Empty selects all accessible, existing profiles; run credentials remain bound to their profile.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Literal substring in task title, summary or session name, including its first-message fallback.

post.summary: Read the active turn session goals
post.description: The current turn context binds the session and profile. Expired contexts, other profiles, group chats and background/delegated runs are rejected. No per-turn task plan is created or modified. Writes upsert only changed/new goals and preserve omitted goals; revision conflicts require rereading. New completions require completion_evidence.

200.description: Current goal ledger; tasks is empty before the first goal is recorded.

400.description: Invalid input, foreign task id, duplicate goal or missing completion evidence.

403.description: The authenticated user cannot access this session profile.

409.description: Context expired, session scope unavailable, or revision changed; reread before retrying.

post.summary: Update the active turn session goals
post.description: The current turn context binds the session and profile. Expired contexts, other profiles, group chats and background/delegated runs are rejected. No per-turn task plan is created or modified. Writes upsert only changed/new goals and preserve omitted goals; revision conflicts require rereading. New completions require completion_evidence.

200.description: Current goal ledger; tasks is empty before the first goal is recorded.

400.description: Invalid input, foreign task id, duplicate goal or missing completion evidence.

403.description: The authenticated user cannot access this session profile.

409.description: Context expired, session scope unavailable, or revision changed; reread before retrying.

title.description: Concise user outcome; reuse the existing goal for refinements and corrections.

summary.description: One or two short sentences about results and remaining blockers. Keep implementation and test logs in the conversation.

completion_evidence.description: Required for newly completed goals: evidence of verified delivery.

200.description: Session list. Supplying offset also returns pagination metadata and the total matching the same visibility, category, and include/exclude filters before pagination.

total.description: Total matching sessions, independent of offset and limit. Present when offset is supplied.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category ID; none selects uncategorized sessions, pinned selects database-pinned sessions.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each session ID.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each session ID.

parameters.name: pinned
parameters.description: Filter by database pin state before pagination and counting. The pinned category takes precedence.

parameters.name: agent_groups
parameters.description: Set to 1 to include legacy native Ekko identities in the builtin_agent history group. Native direct chats are stored as builtin_agent.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: History source to page. With agent_groups=1, builtin_agent selects native Ekko and coding_agent excludes it. Other sources retain their names.

parameters.name: agent_groups
parameters.description: Set to 1 to include legacy native Ekko identities in the builtin_agent history group. Native direct chats are stored as builtin_agent.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Repeat for each deep-linked session ID. Included and pinned sessions do not advance group pagination cursors.

get.description: List selection groups and historyRevision for a local Hermes or Ekko chat. User messages are individual items; agent replies, reasoning and tools are grouped by complete run across pages. Groups touching the compressed prefix are locked. Missing or invalid compression cursors lock all groups. Shared sessions are excluded.

200.description: Message identities for selection (no message bodies)

deleteBlockedReason.description: Present when this group cannot be deleted. A run is locked if any of its messages is protected.

post.description: Permanently delete selected uncompressed messages. Selecting any agent message removes its entire run. Requires an idle local Hermes/Ekko chat and the historyRevision from message-selection. Rechecks the current compression cursor inside the transaction; groups touching the compressed prefix are rejected. Preserves the summary, cursor and compression timestamp while advancing snapshot validity with the history revision. Cached transcript and context estimates are refreshed; billing usage is retained. Returns 409 for compressed or stale selections, unknown compression boundaries, or pending runs/tasks; shared sessions are forbidden.

200.description: Deleted message identities and new history revision

contextTokens.description: Estimated current context after deletion, including the retained summary; null if unavailable. Independent of billed usage.

400.description: Invalid effort, mode or native variant/family

503.description: Native catalog unavailable for validating the paired model change

model.description: Optional literal effort-variant ID for global Cursor/Antigravity sessions. Validated against the native catalog and current family; persisted atomically with effort.

get.description: Returns persisted goals for an accessible Studio session. The current conversation agent reviews them at turn start and records only independent deliverables, ongoing follow-up or explicitly requested tracking. Simple questions, one-off lookups and trivial edits without lasting tracking value are skipped; refinements and corrections reuse the same goal. Eligible goals are created before execution; changed results are saved before the final response. Summaries contain one or two short sentences about results and remaining blockers. Goals span turns and are separate from run plans. Reading goals does not require a write or create a per-turn task-plan card.

200.description: Current goal ledger; tasks is empty before the first goal is recorded.

403.description: The authenticated user cannot access this session profile.

404.description: Session not found, or the explicit profile filter does not match.

get.description: Profile-scoped model pricing in USD per million tokens. Exact provider/model match. Applies only to future calls without reported cost; never reprices historical usage.

put.description: Profile-scoped model pricing in USD per million tokens. Exact provider/model match. Applies only to future calls without reported cost; never reprices historical usage.

get.description: Aggregates one usage origin across accessible Profiles. Defaults to internal (existing sessions and coding agents). External includes every Model API request, even when Studio calls its own endpoint. The categories can represent the same physical upstream call and must not be summed as a deduplicated total. Account means the session owner for internal usage and the authenticated API caller for external usage; unknown historical ownership remains unassigned.

400.description: Invalid origin, account ID or timezone

403.description: Selected Profile is not accessible to this user

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Studio user ID, or unassigned. Omit to include all accounts.

get.description: Directory history and favorites for the authenticated Studio account, shared by Studio and App across Profiles. System-generated workspaces are excluded. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

post.description: Directory history and favorites for the authenticated Studio account, shared by Studio and App across Profiles. System-generated workspaces are excluded. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

400.description: Invalid directory path or favorite value

patch.description: Directory history and favorites for the authenticated Studio account, shared by Studio and App across Profiles. System-generated workspaces are excluded. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

400.description: Invalid directory path or favorite value

get.description: Lists themes owned by the authenticated Studio user. Preserves existing customization as the first theme on initial access.

400.description: Invalid theme settings, name, or deletion of the last theme

404.description: Theme not found for the authenticated user

400.description: Invalid theme settings, name, or deletion of the last theme

404.description: Theme not found for the authenticated user

sourceId.description: Owned theme to duplicate. Omit to create default customization without a wallpaper.

post.summary: Import and activate a theme ZIP as a new theme
post.description: Accepts the ZIP bytes directly, up to 12 MiB. Validates a version 1 manifest (up to 64 KiB) and optional PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF background (up to 10 MiB). Rejects unsupported entries, paths, links, encryption, invalid settings and corrupt/oversized expanded data. Creates a new owned theme and activates it atomically; same-name themes remain separate and existing themes are preserved. On initial migration, query preferences preserve the previous device-only mode/style.

400.description: Invalid or unsupported archive, manifest, settings or entries

413.description: ZIP or background exceeds the allowed size

415.description: Expected ZIP bytes or a supported background image

parameters.name: brightness
parameters.description: Legacy device brightness. Used only when the stored theme has no mode.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Legacy device style. Used only when the stored theme has no style.

400.description: Invalid theme settings, name, or deletion of the last theme

404.description: Theme not found for the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes an owned theme. Deleting the active theme activates the oldest remaining theme; deleting the last theme is rejected.

400.description: Invalid theme settings, name, or deletion of the last theme

404.description: Theme not found for the authenticated user

post.description: Activates an owned theme and restores brightness, style, appearance and wallpaper together.

400.description: Invalid theme settings, name, or deletion of the last theme

404.description: Theme not found for the authenticated user

get.summary: Export an owned theme as a ZIP file
get.description: Downloads an ekko-studio-theme version 1 ZIP containing theme.json and the optional background image. Includes the theme name, modes and all global/regional settings; excludes user IDs, server file paths and preset IDs. Legacy device mode/style query values are fallback values only.

404.description: Theme is not owned by the authenticated user

409.description: The saved background file is missing

parameters.name: brightness
parameters.description: Legacy device brightness. Used only when the stored theme has no mode.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Legacy device style. Used only when the stored theme has no style.

post.summary: Update the current turn task plan
post.description: Update the full ordered plan using the context_id injected into the current run instructions. Expired contexts and other profiles are rejected. Updates are persisted and emitted as plan.updated.

200.description: Persisted task plan snapshot with session_id, run_id, plan_id, revision, execution_state, explanation, plan, created_at and updated_at (milliseconds).

400.description: Invalid plan; at most one step can be in_progress and step ids must be unique.

409.description: Context expired, belongs to another profile, or has no active turn.

post.summary: Ask a user clarification in the current coding-agent turn
post.description: Requires the current interaction context_id and matching authenticated profile. Emits clarify.requested in Studio/App, waits up to five minutes, and returns the answer or an explicit timeout/dismissed/cancelled reason. Expired contexts cannot prompt a later turn. Caller-supplied session/run ids are ignored.

409.description: Expired or inactive context, wrong profile, or another question is pending.

get.description: Establish a WebSocket connection for interactive terminal access. Uses the `ws` or `wss` protocol with `?token=` for authentication.

completion_evidence.description: Concise evidence of verified delivery supplied by the conversation agent.

session_title.description: Conversation display name, using the same first-user-message fallback as the session list when no title is set.

message_id.description: Visible user message beginning the request turn for open tasks or the completion turn for completed tasks. Use with the session/profile to navigate chat.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token
